status: proposal — ExerciseAttempt is not in the local snapshot; field names are inferred from the Cursor Phase-0 audit description
replaces: hardcoded fill-in-the-blank exercises (weeks 0-2) reported in services/exercises.py / _exercise_card.html (audit); this file is the data-driven source instead

fields.exercise_id: exercise_id below (String, <= 40 chars; stable across rebuilds)
fields.score: 0..1 (fill_blank_code: correct_blanks/total_blanks; parsons: 1 if order exact else 0)

grading_rules.fill_blank_code: each blank: answer.strip() in accepted (exact_after_trim); feedback = wrong_feedback[answer] or default_wrong_fa
grading_rules.parsons: submitted order of p-ids equals expected.order; any d-id used => incorrect with its why_wrong_fa; indentation ignored unless indentation_matters
grading_rules.predict_output: answer.strip() in answer.accept (exact_after_trim; multi-line compared line by line after trimming each line)
grading_rules.token_tap: filled tokens in blank order equal expected_answer (list) exactly
grading_rules.challenge_parsons: submitted ids equal correct_order; lines with identical text are interchangeable (see grading_note)
grading_rules.find_the_bug/short_answer: not auto-graded: store text, show key_points_fa after submit, mentor or self review

exercise_attempt_mapping.xp_challenges: Challenges carry xp_reward 5 and xp_reward_session 20 as requested, but per D24 the proposed default awards only the session XP, once, on completing all challenges with correctness >= min_correctness (gamification/xp-config.json#/challenge_session).
exercise_attempt_mapping.xp: No XP per attempt. Mastery XP comes from unit_mastered / lesson_mastered / mastery_test_passed (gamification/xp-config.json). This avoids double counting with xp.award idempotency.
exercise_attempt_mapping.legacy: If the panel keeps its hardcoded exercises for weeks 0-2, map them to these ids by (lesson, type) manually and retire the hardcoded copies; see unresolved-items D11.
